[Español](es/teach.qmd)

Plan and run the {{< var workshop.minutes >}}-minute workshop with the resources
below. The agenda includes the quizzes and breaks. Group activities replace
practice or discussion time; notebook 13 stays take-home work.

## Prepare your session

1. Share the [prerequisites](index.qmd#prerequisites) with learners and ask them
   to run [notebook 00]({{< var repo.colab_base >}}/00-setup-and-data.ipynb) before class.
2. Read the [facilitator guide](facilitator-guide.md) alongside the
   [workshop schedule](tensors_workshop_plan_with_quizzes.md#schedule).
3. Test your selected [notebooks](notebooks.qmd) in fresh runtimes. Follow
   **Core prep**, then **Core activity**, and prepare the
   [slides](slides/en/index.qmd) and [quizzes](kahoot.qmd).

## Teaching resources

- **[Facilitator guide](facilitator-guide.md)** — Prepare the room, follow the section timings, and respond when learners get stuck.
- **[Entry and exit checks](assessments.md)** — Collect individual reasoning at the start and end; use the included key and rubric.
- **[Group tasks](group-tasks.md)** — Choose short discussions with a time box and a concrete group deliverable.
- **[Worked mistakes](worked-mistakes.md)** — Ask learners to predict, test a counterexample, and explain the correction.
- **[Feedback form](workshop-feedback.md)** — Collect two minutes of feedback after the session and choose one improvement for the next run.

## During and after the workshop

Use **Predict → Run → Explain → Check**. Ask for an attempt before opening
solutions, rotate group roles, and keep the scheduled breaks and exit check.
The facilitator guide places the activities within the existing time slots.

After the session, record actual section timings and common errors with the
workshop version you taught. Keep learner responses private and use the
feedback to choose one concrete change for your next session.
